review_authority.section: ## Independent review — Block A delivered-consumer repair — 2026-08-30

claim_limit: Typing inside one delivered read-line capture lifetime only; type-ahead during evaluation is not claimed.

claim_scope.green_consequence: Block A hardware-accepted; v1.5 fast-typing Known Issue pensioned

collection_derivation.proof: 199 * 1 > 192; at least one collection while read-line capture is armed

controller.purpose: nested read-line owns the measured origin; print gives the numeric oracle; wait keeps counters stable before the next prompt can re-zero them

counter_witness.origin: atomic zero at nested read-line entry while capture tail is closed

decision_table.equal-but-not-136: session choreography/count invalid; no product verdict
decision_table.oracle-7-and-136=136=136=136: Block A hardware-accepted; v1.5 fast-typing Known Issue pensioned

status: READY: V1.9 BLOCK-A R8 COUNTER CONTACT

steps.action: cold boot V19R8P.D81 alone and wait for the live lisp65> prompt
steps.expect: normal r8 native prompt; no optional library

steps.action: enter exactly (progn (setq s (read-line)) (print (string-length s)) (wait 16383)) and press Return
steps.expect: a fresh blank nested read-line row appears

steps.action: six times type exactly 01234567012345670123456701234567; verify its four 8-character groups; after each pass press Delete/Backspace exactly 32 times as four counted groups of eight until the row is blank
steps.expect: passes 1-2 ordinary and 3-6 fast; every token is exact and the row becomes blank exactly on deletion 32
7 is printed and no new prompt appears while wait is active

steps.action: leave the keyboard untouched; Codex stops the CPU once and reads $BCFC..$BCFF read-only
steps.expect: four bytes are 88 88 88 88 (hex), i.e. 136 each; no resume

stimulus.delete_discipline: exactly four sets of eight individual Delete/Backspace presses; no hold/repeat; row must be blank after the 32nd
